🪨 Rachid pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (86 stone now.)
🍲 Owen cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Owen worked the smoke racks too — 3 batches preserved (~678 kcal, keeps for weeks).
Owen wanders off. "I want to see what's out there."
🌿 Giulia returns from foraging the wilds: +274 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 274 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.

🔥 The fire settles. Giulia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Owen mutters "So it bleeds." Onni asks "We've been walking past those." Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
You asked how exactly the cut happened, how deep, how long it bled. The questions kept going past concern into something else. You noticed being noticed, and stopped. Smiled.
People will notice: asks detailed questions about other people's injuries — a little too interested. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Luigi telling Onni about Someone. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
🧳 A traveler says Emberhold burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the hardliners walked. The Bloodied is the new fire.)
💔 Thornfield has split over blood — the hardliners walked, and they didn't walk far. The Bloodied II is a new fire in the world now — 6 people under Maya.
They didn't come to your fire. Hardliners don't ask — Maya is building something out there, and it isn't a farm.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2308 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
The fire is quiet today. Nobody's talking much.
Rachid came back with 490 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 245 kcal in, 245 kcal eaten at the fire.
Luigi is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 85/100)
🍽️ Owen carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
🌿 Blackberry, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the northeast. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
— DAY 27 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Wild Black Cherry — named and noted.
◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+4 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Carolina — 💧 Fetch water. Carolina nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Equipped Warden's Cloak (torso).
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone." (Talk to Luigi.)
🌱 Luigi waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Luigi checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Luigi hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (457 logs now.)
💧 Carolina returns with 15L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Carolina telling Rodrigo about Giulia. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
💬 Rodrigo says: "Do you think they're watching right now? The... audience? I try not to think about it."
🚶 Onni is back — found Owen.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Rachid telling Luigi about themself. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — Luigi telling Rachid about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Carolina telling Onni about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🚶 Carolina is back — found Owen.
🧭 Rodrigo is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Luigi telling Rodrigo about Owen. The retelling is already better than the event.
You catch fragments by the fire — Giulia telling Luigi about Onni. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
Onni showed Carolina the Wild Black Cherry — "remember it." Word gets around.
👥 Carolina sets out to find Owen. "Won't be long."
👥 Luigi walks out with Carolina. "Nobody walks alone today."
Giulia is sweeping ash and grit out through the door, steady strokes.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
